description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget for reading and interacting with news articles within a mobile application. It includes UI components, WebView integration, Text-to-Speech (TTS) functionality, and actions such as sharing, saving, and browsing articles.

classes.name: ReadArticleArgs
classes.description: A data class for passing the news article to the read screen.

classes.name: ReadArticleScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a news article in a WebView with TTS controls and menu actions.

methods.name: _configureTts
methods.description: Initializes TTS language and speech rate configurations.

methods.name: _handleMoreAction
methods.description: Handles user actions from the popup menu, such as sharing, saving, or browsing the article.

methods.name: _ttsText
methods.description: Generates the text to be used for TTS, including a paywall message.

methods.name: _play
methods.description: Triggers TTS to speak the article content.

methods.name: _applyRateAndPlay
methods.description: Applies the selected speech rate and plays the TTS.

methods.name: _applyVoiceAndPlay
methods.description: Sets the TTS voice based on user selection and restarts speech.
